post.text:
The Luxon Govt’s new funding for homelessness is a drop in the bucket to address the crisis in New Zealand.

Community organisations are telling us that homelessness is at the highest level in New Zealand's history. To tackle the issue, we need more than a trickle of funding from this Govt.

source.agency_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand
